payload.description_html:
Morosaurus impar. Right forelimb or leg or foot of herbivorous dinosaur, on wood pedestal for exhibit. Height, exclusive of base, 10 feet 11 inches. Collected 1899. Later called Camarasaurus impar (Marsh). Column, radiator, exhibit hall visible in background. Plate shows evidence of painting. Field Columbian Museum. 1900.

Original size and material: 8x10 inch glass negative Digital Identifier: CSGEO2959

Part of the Illinois Urban Landscapes Project: www.fieldmuseum.org/urbanlandscapes/
